reviewer: assistant full-response review; not an independent human review
method: All 42 complete visible responses read alongside the frozen tasks; requests and original excerpt presence checked separately. Evidence quotes below are literal substrings. Verdicts are manual judgments, not keyword scores.
defaults_note: Apply each record's overrides to defaults. Admission pass means the recorded pre-fix run admitted the frozen eligible SQL originals, not that post-retrieval revocation was tested or that citations were faithful. A missing required answer fails factual fidelity even if no alternative fact was asserted. Completion fails on truncation/repetitive derailment, distinct from a complete but wrong-task answer.
